user.title: Add electricity-price and CO2 forecast
user.description: Choose a market and the forecast horizon. Public access currently provides up to 48 hours; an eligible API key can unlock 120 hours.

data.cheapest_hours_count: Cheapest hours to track (0 to disable)

data_description.horizon_hours: The API reports the actually permitted horizon as a diagnostic sensor.
data_description.window_hours: Length of the cheapest and greenest continuous window.
data_description.api_key: Leave empty for public access. The key is stored in the Home Assistant config entry.
data_description.retail_pricing: Adds an assumption-based all-in price (grid fee, levies, VAT) in addition to the market price. Only available for some markets; not an exact supplier tariff.
data_description.postal_code: Required for Germany when retail pricing is enabled, used for the grid-fee lookup. Not used for other markets.
data_description.update_interval_minutes: How often to poll the API. Data resolution is 15 minutes, so shorter intervals rarely add new information.
data_description.cheapest_hours_count: Adds entities for the N cheapest hours of each individual calendar day (not N total across the whole horizon), which may be non-contiguous - useful for automations like running an appliance during the cheapest hours, every day.
